description: Turn off a share link on a deck, flyer, page, t-shirt or brochure immediately — the token stops answering (404, indistinguishable from one that never existed) but the row stays for the audit trail. There is no undo; create_share mints a new link if sharing resumes.

id.description: The deck id (list_decks) or artifact id (list_artifacts) being shared

name: revoke_share
title: Revoke a share link
